review_scope: Read-only independent audit of PR143 CI terrain preview initialization stall; no production edits/Cargo/build/commits. Earlier placement review remains frozen separately.

executed_defect.severity: High: valid simultaneous browser connections can stall preview initialization indefinitely while keep-alive connections remain open.
executed_defect.case: Schedule a six-connection HTTP/1.1 keep-alive burst against frozen preview on one CPU after its initial four connection-reader workers are idle.
executed_defect.limit: Observed each held-open phase for0.5s; source-level task/ownership inspection explains the unbounded wait rather than interpreting a finite timeout as proof of forever.

static_root_cause.owner: tiny_http0.12 TaskPool connection-reader admission, not Preview response workers.
static_root_cause.mechanism: TaskPool::spawn checks waiting_tasks==0 without accounting for previously queued work consuming those same idle workers. A burst can enqueue more accepted connections than idle readers. Four readers then remain in persistent per-client ClientConnection::next/read loops. Queued accepted connections get no reader until an owning connection closes or a later accept happens to create another reader. Preview cannot receive an HTTP Request from a socket whose connection-reader task remains queued.
static_root_cause.response_owner: Preview has four response workers, but they wait on a separate parsed-request queue; increasing this count does not repair connection-reader admission.
static_root_cause.failed_header_workaround: Response::add_header rejects Connection headers, so normal with_header(Connection: close) would be silently ignored.

cesium_review.observation: Cesium3DTileset.fromUrl awaits loadJson/resource.fetchJson XHR before assigning window.terrain. An unserved socket leaves its promise pending without page/HTTP failure and therefore prevents terrainSurface/loaded initialization.

CI_inference.status: The captured hasViewer=true/terrain=false/Loading/no errors and final tileset XHR after a burst of images is consistent with the reproduced reader starvation. CI did not record socket completion/connection traces, so exact CI socket mapping is inferred, not directly executed here.

fix_acceptance_requirements: Repair queue-aware connection-reader admission at its owner, or replace transport with one whose connection ownership is independently established.
Retain old frozen-artifact four-versus-six burst/release control as a sensitive reproducer.
Fixed artifact must serve all six burst requests while every keep-alive remains open; no timeout increase, response-worker increase or browser retry is evidence of that property.
Replay route/path/MIME/GET/HEAD/security behavior and actual unchanged terrain browser consumer after the transport fix.
Keep fixed source/artifact identities distinct from this baseline frozen defect.
